---
title: "Priority list"
---

::: {.disclaimer}
Provisional model estimates, not IUCN assessments. This ranking is meant to direct
assessment effort, not to stand in for it.
:::

Species ranked by the median predicted probability of being threatened, across every
model that has been run for them. Species where models disagree are flagged, and a flag
is a reason to look at the species page before acting on the number.

```{=html}
<div class="filters">
  <select id="group"><option value="">All groups</option></select>
  <label style="align-self:center">
    Show top
    <input id="topn" type="number" min="10" max="1000" step="10" value="100" style="width:5rem">
  </label>
  <label style="align-self:center">
    <input id="hidelow" type="checkbox"> Hide species where models disagree
  </label>
</div>

<p id="count" style="color:#667"></p>
<div id="table"></div>

<script src="table.js"></script>
<script>
loadIndex(function (data) {
  renderControls(data, { priority: true });
  renderTable(data, { priority: true });
});
</script>
```
